timing_verdict.label: GOOD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: GOOD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,300–1,330 KRW/USD

WHY: The won has strengthened significantly—rallying ~130–135 KRW in one month—meaning you are currently getting more dollars per won spent. News sources describe this as a major "decline in high exchange rates" and relief from the previous 1,600 won fear level. Although some forecasts suggest the rate may test 1,300 won or even drift toward 1,500 won by year-end, the current stable and strengthened won (supported by corporate conversions and authorities' stabilization measures) represents a favorable entry point relative to recent highs.

TIP: Lock in this month's $2,000 conversion now while the won is strong; if rates weaken further toward 1,500 won later in the year, your fixed monthly obligation will become more expensive in KRW terms.
